principle: Preserve existing APIs and exposed contracts as far as possible for seamless upper application migration. Prefer additive metadata and lower-layer compatibility adapters. Do not invent scalar role/profile business mappings.

scope.cashflow_consumer: Supplied filesystem source; no independent Git checkout. Do not attribute the parent Workbench HEAD as a Cashflow revision. Exact source hashes retained.

preserved_contracts.contract: HTTP routes, headers, and top-level authentication response
preserved_contracts.fact: Login, Entra login, validate, and relogin retain existing paths and response fields. entitlementRouting is additive. Existing entities, drawers, entitlementsToken, and userInfo remain.

preserved_contracts.contract: EMS2 entity and signed entitlement representation
preserved_contracts.fact: EMS2 paths preserve entity name, roleName, subjects/actions, and entityName:roleName token keys. New CES fields are nullable/additive.
preserved_contracts.limit: Preservation applies while the legacy entity is still fetched. Dual-read fetches entities only from EMS2-scoped rows.

preserved_contracts.contract: Profile display for current shared base consumer
preserved_contracts.fact: Current base displays roleList for CES and uses structured CES subject.actions. It keeps roleName and token lookup for EMS2.
preserved_contracts.limit: Source inspection; deployed base version unknown.

compatibility_limits.classification: existing known migration compatibility gap; additional to the four technical review findings
compatibility_limits.confidence: high for source data flow; runtime/backend consequence unverified
compatibility_limits.setup: An authenticated user has only CES entities, no legacy X_RATANONE row, and no legacy user.entitlement scalar-role fallback.
compatibility_limits.old_result: EMS2 X_RATANONE row supplies roleName. getUser().role exposes that scalar. Cashflow uses it as an authorization profile.
compatibility_limits.new_result: BFF CES mapper sets name to CES application name and roleList to all assignment names. id, roleId, and roleName remain null. Current shared getUser() does not select a CES scalar role.
compatibility_limits.consumer_consequence: Cashflow pending-verification details call getUserRole(), then checkAuthLimit({profile,...}). The service URL includes data.profile directly, so this setup produces an undefined profile path segment. This proves a source-level legacy request-contract mismatch; backend outcome and user blocking remain untested.
compatibility_limits.minimal_correction: Keep getUser() API and the upper call unchanged. Resolve an authoritative CES-to-legacy authorization-profile rule in the lower compatibility layer. Preserve actual legacy entities during transition when authorized and available. Do not join roleList or select its first item.
compatibility_limits.owner: unknown; requires authorization-profile policy or provider mapping authority
limits: If a legacy X_RATANONE row remains in an EMS2-scoped tile, the scalar role may still be available. The gap is therefore conditional, not universal.
Cashflow_Authorization_Limits/Main/utils/index.ts current helper derives Maker/Checker/Visitor from permission codes; do not confuse it with the MultiExceptions scalar profile path.

compatibility_limits.classification: known exposed semantic contract change with a concrete telemetry consumer; generic direct-reader impact remains scoped
compatibility_limits.old_result: Signed entitlement JSON uses X_RATANONE:<legacyRole> when that legacy entity is returned.
compatibility_limits.new_result: CES projection has name RATAN_ENTITLEMENT_RULE and null roleName for the supplied application. The unchanged serializer therefore emits RATAN_ENTITLEMENT_RULE:null. Additive roleList/applicationId do not retain the old token key.
compatibility_limits.consumer_consequence: Base.handleUser stores decoded token entitlements unchanged. Current telemetry getUserProfile searches X_RATANONE and returns blank for a CES-only token. No direct Cashflow production user.entitlements reader was found in this bounded search.
compatibility_limits.minimal_correction: Keep CES identity metadata. Add a trusted legacy compatibility projection only where a canonical entity/profile mapping exists. Alternatively adapt the shared telemetry layer to an agreed CES profile display contract. Do not invent role attribution.
limits: Blank telemetry profile has minimal demonstrated session impact. It is not a release blocker here.
No arbitrary direct JWT reader is claimed without an inspected caller.

compatibility_limits.classification: known conditional role-sensitive behavior boundary; outside the four service defects
compatibility_limits.fact: Saved view/filter queries pass getUser().role as assignee/moduleOwner when View_Builder_POC is enabled. Current shared write guards explicitly reject pending CES role-owned operations. Two settlement-client-data helpers explicitly deny CES until the multi-role exclusion policy exists.
compatibility_limits.minimal_correction: Retain current public helper signatures. Supply approved lower-layer role ownership and exclusion policy before claiming behavior parity. Functional permission union alone cannot define ownership or a scalar profile.
limits: Backend saved-item visibility was not executed.
This records explicit current restrictions, not a newly reproduced service defect.

compatibility_limits.fact: Current base admin role selector requires entity.name FMO PORTAL ADMIN and scalar roleName. BFF admin validation parses FMO PORTAL ADMIN:<role> from the entitlement token. Generic CES app-name metadata does not by itself preserve this contract.
compatibility_limits.minimal_correction: Keep administration on the existing EMS2 contract until an authoritative admin identity/role mapping preserves both consumers.
limits: No configured CES administrator rollout or failing admin session was established.

accepted_intent.fact: Candidate knowledge version6 records the 9 November user decision: existing hasPermission(code) can accept mapped EMS2 or CES grants with source logs. This decision is not challenged or reported as a defect.
accepted_intent.limit: Intent acceptance does not establish that every deployed shared container already implements the union. This follow-up does not add another provider-union finding.

accepted_intent.fact: Preserve the accepted distinct meanings: entity.name RATAN_ENTITLEMENT_RULE, entity.applicationName RATAN, entity.applicationId 51358. Keeping old APIs does not authorize reverting these accepted identities. Legacy compatibility, when needed, must use a trusted additive projection or shared adapter.

relation_to_original_findings: REV-001 through REV-004 remain technical correction items. These compatibility entries explain exposed semantic contracts and their limits. They do not silently increase the confirmed-defect count.
execution: No new test or service/browser execution. Claims are source-derived and source-bound. No reviewed production code changed.
